title: benchmarkEvaluate
responsibility: Evaluates only allowed implementation changes against a fresh baseline with protected acceptance checks.

inputs.name: evaluateBenchmarkSubmission.input
inputs.description: Pinned baseline, trial changes, protected files and shared abort signal.

inputs.name: setupBenchmarkWorkspace.cwd
inputs.description: Working directory in which the trusted command runs.

inputs.name: setupBenchmarkWorkspace.definition
inputs.description: Validated benchmark contract, setup commands and acceptance checks.

inputs.name: setupBenchmarkWorkspace.signal
inputs.description: Abort signal sharing the trial deadline and user cancellation.

outputs.name: evaluateBenchmarkSubmission
outputs.description: Protected-file violations, acceptance outcomes and the evaluated implementation patch.

outputs.name: setupBenchmarkWorkspace
outputs.description: Completes trusted setup commands or rejects the failed setup.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects cancelled evaluation or failed setup commands.
